notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing.
You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least six 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod five times by sacrificing five Zombie Knights, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
